tips: Show real class activity: doubt-solving clips, board work, student results (with permission).
Board-exam season (Jan-Mar) is your key window — start outreach 2 months before.
Offer a free demo class in locality groups and via WhatsApp to nearby parents.
Collect parent testimonials and post them on your Google Business Profile.
Tie up with nearby schools' stationery shops or translators for cross-promotion.
commonMistakes: Generic flyers with no batch timing, class strength or demo-class hook.
Promoting only at exam time when parents decide months earlier.
No review strategy — parents check Google ratings before enrolling.
exampleOffers: Free 1-week demo class before each new batch.
Sibling or group-of-3 discount on monthly fees.
Early-bird fee saving for enrolling 30 days before the batch starts.
